name: system_diff_build
description: Gathers git diffs, parses hunks, and compiles self-contained 5-layer HTML system change reports. Compatible with skill: 'system-diff' (.agents/skills/system-diff/SKILL.md) for architectural review, decision framing, and layer isolation rules.

baseRef.description: Base Git reference or commit SHA (e.g. 'main', 'origin/main').

headRef.description: Head Git reference or commit SHA.

specFile.description: JSON spec containing title, answer, decisions, system map, and part annotations.

output.description: Target path for the compiled self-contained HTML report.
